source: owner review of 82-0.com (26 screenshots, 2026-09-02), used as interaction evidence only; no competitor asset is referenced at runtime

decisions.element: Simple visual mode selection (three cards on the home surface)
decisions.how: A dedicated Play Lobby at / and /play with three primary cards and a quieter secondary row, read from the one navigation registry.

decisions.element: One obvious action at a time
decisions.how: One action per lobby card; one primary CTA per Time Arena state (already the arena's rule, now attributed and measured).
The coach section is visibly subdued while not actionable (data-active); placeholder staffs desaturate on an empty board. Nothing is hidden, nothing competes.
Three rolls, named FOUNDATION · ADAPT · COMMIT, with completed rolls compressed to ticks; a guest's three runs stated on the abandon dialog.
Chaos progression stays on explicit decisions (hold, lock, hire, run) — the decisions ARE the game.

decisions.element: Eligible-position highlighting when a player is selected
decisions.how: Player-first placement with four worded slot states, auto-placement for one legal slot, a legal swap workflow, Undo, duplicate-person refusal and a screen-reader announcement — from authoritative card data.
The Result Dock leads with the Story; Box Score, Coaching and Analysis stay one tap away. Depth on demand, not removed.
Accounts, friends, leaderboards and XP are Phases 9B–9C by decision; the existing header nav is unchanged.
Same mode names, order, glyphs, statuses and sentences on desktop, tablet, phone and PWA; only the physical layout reflows.
EraClash reports simulated results, never a projected record or grading vocabulary.

decisions.element: Dark-orange colour identity, logo, icons, text, slot animation
decisions.how: EraClash Logo Mk1, near-black arena base, silver, gold, cobalt and coach violet; original stroke glyphs; original copy.

decisions.element: Sign-in prompt on the result and leaderboard rank
decisions.how: Phase 9B (accounts) and 9C (leaderboards). Not built here; no fake sign-in.
Out of scope by decision; Fantasy remains its own pillar and is not mixed into Play.

decisions.element: Ads between the game and the player
